data.name: Name
data.mobile_action: Show "Mailbox emptied" action in the push notification

data_description.vibration_sensor: Binary sensor that triggers when mail is dropped in.
data_description.mobile_action: Adds a button (iOS and Android) to the notification that marks the mailbox as emptied.
data_description.repeat_message: Sent when the sensor triggers again while mail is still present (with the "emptied" action).
data_description.debounce_seconds: Further vibrations within this time are ignored.
data_description.mobile_targets: Services such as mobile_app_iphone. Multiple devices possible.

data.name: Name
data.block_action: If the door is open when locking
data.open_alert_minutes: Warn when door is open after (minutes, 0 = off)
data.manual_override: When the lock is operated manually

data_description.contact: Reports the door open (on) or closed (off). Required for the warning and for the check before locking.
data_description.block_action: Only notify, or lock automatically once the door is closed.
data_description.manual_override: Manual operation = a lock state change that was not caused by the door guard.
data_description.mobile_targets: Services such as mobile_app_iphone. Multiple devices possible.

error.no_method: At least one notification method with a target must be enabled.
error.tts_incomplete: Voice announcement needs a TTS service and a speaker.
error.alert_needs_contact: The "door open too long" warning needs a door contact (or set the warning to 0).
error.no_contact: This trigger needs a door contact in the settings.
error.door_closed_needs_lock: This trigger only makes sense for "Lock".
